Battery along the way

Battery Reserve + buffer

Your charging stops

Built around your reserve. Estimates include a simplified weight and terrain model, charging losses and a 5-minute overhead per stop. Battery health, traffic, weather and charger performance can change the result. Confirm each stop in the operator app.
YOUR GARAGE

My vehicles

Save cars in this browser. Switching updates energy, terrain, battery estimates and compatible charging stops.

Editable estimates, not a verified vehicle catalogue. Check your exact trim and usable battery. Charging uses a simplified taper curve. A new profile starts with the current car’s values—replace them before saving. CCS2 and Type 2 are currently supported.

FREE MAPS. FREE NAVIGATION LINKS.

No keys. No billing setup.

EV Route displays OpenStreetMap data through OpenFreeMap and MapLibre. No Google SDK, API key or paid routing API is loaded.

Google Maps opens separately with your destination and stops in order. Map hosting is free; provider outages can still affect availability.

OSRM provides road distance, a route line and driving time without live traffic. Battery estimates include sampled Copernicus terrain from Open-Meteo. Charging stations come from eŞarjRadar’s EPDK-derived records. Live availability is not provided.
